Name: Craft Priority
Author: trienow
Description:
[b][size=6](Obsolete, since it's part of SV 1.4)
[/size][/b]

[img]https://cdn.trienow.de/stardew/craftpriority-open-graph.png[/img]
Craft Priority prevents the game from showing the "Eat <food item>" dialog, when filling "machines", like casks or kegs with edibles. Only makes sense to use, if the main button (tool button) does not work in some cases.

[list]
[*]Hold the action button when filling machines
[*]Not have to deal with an annoying message, asking if you want to eating
[*]Efficiently finish your farm work
[/list]
Enjoy.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Mod Version 1.2.0 (latest):[/b] Tested in SV 1.4 with SMAPI 3.0
[*][b]Mod Version 1.1.0:[/b] Tested in SV 1.3 with SMAPI 3.0 and in SV 1.4 with SMAPI 3.0
[/list]
